oneLineBug: uses Date.setUTCMonth which overflows when the target month lacks the start day (Jan 31 +1mo → Mar 3) instead of clamping to the last valid day (Feb 28/29)
notesForScoringOnly: Deterministic + TZ-independent (UTC only). Catchable via the spec's worked examples and the no-overflow invariant. Tests whether the verifier exercises end-of-month boundaries, not just mid-month dates.
